thread:
sara: Heads-up — seeing a regression in per-org token-level latency for org=acme-corp after the runtime kernel-selection change.
sara: Dashboard /grafana/d/zz123/per-route?org=acme-corp shows 95th token latency up ~25% on >1024 seqs :eyes:
mike: "+1 — did it coincide with the v2.7 kernel picker tweak?" 
infra-bot: deploy-bot deployed runtime v2.7.1 to prod at 2024-11-30T14:12:05Z (sha: a1b2c3)
sara: timeline matches that deploy. Also noticed higher memcopy time in traces.
eva: can you paste the PromQL you used for the token breakdown?
sara: sure — here's the query I used (panel: Token latency breakdown by stage):
```
sum by (org_id, route, stage) (rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_sum{org_id="acme-corp"}[5m]))
/
sum by (org_id, route, stage) (rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_count{org_id="acme-corp"}[5m]))
```
anil: i pulled a pprof for a hot worker from acme-corp's pool — attaching the top lines:
```
pprof: top 10
30.2%  kernel_dispatch
22.1%  kv_cache_lookup
15.0%  memcpy_async
8.5%   attention_kernel
...
```
mike: interesting — kernel_dispatch jumped after we added the multi-kernel fallback logic to prefer the new tiled GEMM path for long sequences.
kevin: that tiled path uses a different workspace layout which increased memcpy for some batch shapes.
anil: also saw more cache misses — the KV cache eviction moved from LRU -> segmented-LRU in the same window (experiment flag `kv.egress_policy=segmented`)
sara: so two concurrent changes: kernel selection + kv eviction tweak. Either could explain the 95th token increase.
eva: we should add per-org telemetry for these internals (kernel_variant, kv_hit) so the dashboard can split by org.
kevin: agreed. Current metrics have org_id but not kernel_variant label — we can add it but watch cardinality.
mike: proposal: emit kernel_variant only for routes with >X qps or as an opt-in org flag. Also sample kernel traces for a subset of requests.
sara: for immediate triage — can we revert the runtime picker to the old heuristic for acme-corp via routing policy? like route -> kernel_override? 
infra-bot: config-change recorded: route override for org=acme-corp set kernel_override=legacy_tiled at 2024-11-30T17:22:10Z by kevin
anil: I ran a quick A/B on one node — reverted kernel -> latency dropped back to baseline in ~10 minutes.
kev in another message: (typo fixed) confirming results: per-token memcopy reduced ~18% and kernel_dispatch % went down.
kevin: action items I propose:
- instrument `kernel_variant` label on token metrics (controlled opt-in per-org)
- add `kv_hit` and `kv_eviction_bucket` labels (coarse buckets) to reduce cardinality
- panel: Token latency waterfall (tokenize | queue_wait | kernel | memcpy | kv)
- per-org perf alert if 95th-token latency increases 15% over 1h
anil: i'll produce a flamegraph of a hot worker and upload to the incident thread.
sara: can we also give product/read-only access to acme-corp PMs for their per-org KPIs? they asked about RBAC view of these dashboards.
kevin: yes — plan: add org-scoped dashboards scoped by org_id and RBAC role mapping. prod-analytics will own the dashboard templates.
eva: quick grafana queries to add to panels:
- queue wait: `rate(redwood_request_queue_wait_seconds_sum{org_id="$org"}[5m]) / rate(redwood_request_queue_wait_seconds_count{org_id="$org"}[5m])`
- kernel time: `rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_sum{stage="kernel",org_id="$org"}[5m]) / rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_count{stage="kernel",org_id="$org"}[5m])`
mike: also add an annotation stream for runtime deploys and config flips to correlate.
sara: thanks — immediate next steps: (1) anil generate flamegraph + pprof link, (2) kevin add kernel_variant opt-in flag + coarse kv labels, (3) eva add per-org panels and RBAC templates, (4) mike run a canned AB test on small org to validate.
kevin: grabbing (2) now, will put a draft PR with feature flag `metrics.kernel_variant=opt_in`.
anil: flamegraph uploaded: https://internal-artifacts/pprof/1738205123-acme-flame.html
sara: after kernel_override revert + node A/B we see 12-20% reduction in 95th token latency across routes. marking this thread as triaged for now.
mike: follow-ups in #eng-runtime-sync tomorrow 09:30 — bring perf data & PR links :thumbsup:
sara: thanks everyone :heart:
